page_title: AUX 3-0 MAR | Auxerre v Marseille 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' 3 - 0 Jubal Junior (Auxerre) rose high above the defence to head the ball over the goalkeeper and inside the net.
90+1' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Substitution. Hamed Junior Traore makes his way off the pitch and Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) comes on as his replacement.
88' Substitution. Kevin Danois did his best and is replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
87' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Ki-Jana Hoever is replaced by Paul Joly (Auxerre).
86' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' It's time for a substitution. Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) comes on in place of Mason Greenwood.
85' Here comes a substitution. Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) is brought on as a substitute for Gideon Mensah.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
81' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia will be replaced by Ulisses Garcia (Marseille).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pol Lirola (Marseille) comes onto the pitch so that Luis Henrique can be given a rest.
80' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' 2 - 0 GOAL! Jubal Junior (Auxerre) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Geronimo Rulli in goal.
77' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
75' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle and signals a foul after Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) brought his opponent down. That's a penalty to Auxerre! They have a good chance to score now.
73' Auxerre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
71' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jeremy Stinat who sees an offensive foul.
70' The referee awards a corner and Amine Gouiri (Marseille) goes over to take it.
66' Marseille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:3.
63' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) will not be there to see the end of the game as he is shown a second yellow card instantly followed by red, and the game is over for him.
61' The substitution has been made. Amar Dedic (Marseille) has replaced Quentin Merlin.
61' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Neal Maupay (Marseille) replaces Ismael Bennacer.
60' Substitution. Theo Bair will be replaced by Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre).
59' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) is the one who receives a yellow card.
57' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
55' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. The ball heads right towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.
54' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
52' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Marseille due to an offside in the build-up play.
52' Wait! Referee Jeremy Stinat has indicated he is going to review the Marseille goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
51' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
50' Marseille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

49' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
48' Theo Bair (Auxerre) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
47' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The ball is cleared after Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' The goal by Auxerre won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
45+4' The Auxerre players halt their celebrations as referee Jeremy Stinat makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45+2' Theo Bair (Auxerre) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Marseille.

41' What a miss! The corner finds Jubal Junior (Auxerre) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
41' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner.
40' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
38' Derek Cornelius (Marseille) is yellow-carded.
34' 1 - 0 Wonderful movement! Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) makes a good run to pick up a cross on the edge of the box and sends an accurate shot into the top left corner.
34' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' Marseille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
31' A crossfield pass from Donovan Leon (Auxerre) fails to find any of his teammates.
30' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
27' Luis Henrique (Marseille) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Donovan Leon intercepts the ball.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:2.
26' The Marseille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
24' Marseille take a short corner kick.
21' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
16' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
16' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:1.
15' Neat passing move from Marseille in order to create new attacking opportunities.
13' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Donovan Leon is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
13' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' Good team movement sets up Amine Gouiri (Marseille) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
9' Great teamplay by Marseille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 13:87.
2' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Marseille will kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will supervise the game today.
